question: Should this maintainer-scoped Discord runtime split merge after redacted live Discord evidence verifies reaction lifecycle, reply delivery, and cleanup parity?
rationale: The protected maintainer label requires explicit human handling, and the remaining gate is behavioral proof of a transport runtime rather than a narrow mechanical code repair.

options.title: Request live Discord proof
options.body: Obtain a redacted runtime transcript, terminal output, or recording that shows an inbound turn through acknowledgement, reply delivery, and terminal cleanup before merging.

options.title: Accept test-only confidence
options.body: Merge based on the focused suite and changed-gate coverage while explicitly accepting the remaining lack of real transport-runtime evidence.
